negative_reviews.author: Claire Oldfield
negative_reviews.text: Nice server but not attentive at all. No one checked in to see if our meal was okay or we'd have had the opportunity to point out we were missing a dish. Bowls cleared and we pointed out the dish never arrived and we were asked "oh would you like it taking off your bill?" Errr yes, I think so. Ohhh but there's a 10% service charge for the table of 2 so I guess if the tip is forced, there's no need to make an effort! Really disappointed in the service. Food, as usual, was lovely.

issues: Sales missed target by £211.68 (0.31%) and were £607.74 (0.9%) down on the week before, within the 3% variance threshold, while year on year sales remain well up (SJQ GM/HC meeting 24/11 and EDI/NEW KPI meeting 24/11).
Covers fell by 40, but spend per head rose to £22.29, above the £22 target.
Wages were 21% with few cuts needed, the labour split was 44.33% FOH and 55.67% BOH against a 45% and 55% target, and food cost was 22.91%.
Food usage variance was 2.7% and wet usage variance 2.8%, both within range.
Best sellers were Steak Tataki Ramen (462), Chicken Ramen (399) and Chicken Gyoza (313); the weakest were octopus, scallop and sea bream nigiri (1 each).
Drinks hit the 10% sales mix target, but sushi (20% target) and sides (13.5% target) did not.
Reviews: seven 5 star, one 4 star, two 3 star and one 2 star, and negative reviews left without comments were sent follow up requests.
Birthday ramen redemptions jumped to 33 last week against an average of about five, and a month long December incentive is planned to lift spend per head.
The audit scored 9 out of 10 on intangibles, with a note to raise the sushi TV volume near the front door.
Weekly hygiene compliance was 100%; pest control is due on 30/11, and fire, electrical, gas and ventilation are up to date.
December holidays across BOH and FOH mean sushi cover is still needed for the first two weeks of December.
Mapal photo uploads fail on the phone app but work on desktop, and maintenance logging is moving to Ross's new app, which still needs a memo from Ross.
Teddy tested the new table QR codes and found them more complicated than the existing site specific system.
The M7 projector needs a new bulb after cleaning the lens did not help; Chris is sorting it, due Friday (Admin Meeting 23/11).
Promotions: XOXO, the Christmas menu, seasonal matcha and the Yuzu Margarita.
